div.head: II Eg 3
div.ab: ⁊ síe ælcre geoguðe teoðung gelæst be pentecosten ⁊ þara eorðwæstma be emnihte; ⁊ ælc cyricsceat sy gelæst be Martinus mæssan, be þam fullon wite, þe seo domboc tæcð.
⁊ sy ælcre geogoðe teoþung gelæst be pentecosten ⁊ ðara eorðwæstma be emnihte ⁊ ælc cyricsceat to Martinus mæssan, be ðan fullan wite, ðe seo dómboc tæcð.
⁊ sy ælcere geoguðe teoðinge gelæst be pentecosten ⁊ ðara eorðwæstma be emnihte ⁊ ælc ciricsceat to Martinus mæssan, be þam fullan wite, þe seo domboc tæcð.
Et omnis decimatio iuuentutis reddita sit ad pentecosten et terre frugum ad equinoctium et omne cyricsceattum ad festum sancti Martini, per plenam forisfacturam, quam iudicialis liber dicit.
[Be teoþungum.] ⁊ sy ælcere geoguðe teoðinge gelæst be pentecosten ⁊ ðara eorðwæstma be emnihte ⁊ ælc ciricsceat to Martinus mæssan, be þam fullan wite þe seo domboc tæcð.
And sie ælcre geoguðe teoðung gelæst be Pentecosten and þara eorðwæstma be emnihte, and ælc cyricsceat sy gelæst be Martinus mæssan, be þam fullon wite, þe seo domboc tæcð.

(Von Zehnten. Ld) Und von jedem Jungvieh werde Zehnt zu Pfingsten entrichtet und von den Feldfrüchten zur Nachtgleiche [um 23. Sept.]; und jede Kirchensteuer (werde entrichtet G Ld) zum Martinsfest, bei der vollen Strafe, die das Gesetzbuch vorschreibt.

(Of tithes. Ld) And let the tithe of all young stock be paid by Pentecost, and of the fruits of the earth by the equinox [about 23 September]; and every church-scot (be paid, G Ld) by Martinmas, on pain of the full fine which the law-book prescribes.

And the tithe of all young animals shall be rendered by Pentecost, and that of the fruits of the earth by the Equinox, and every church due shall be rendered by Martinmas, under pain of the full penalty which the written law prescribes.

And the tithe of all young stock is to be rendered by Pentecost, and of all the fruits of the earth by the Equinox, and all church-scot is to be rendered by Martinmas, under pain of the full fine, which the law-book prescribes.

And the tithe of all the young animals is to be paid by Pentecost, and that of the fruits of the earth by the equinox, and all Church dues are to be paid by the Feast of Saint Martin, or suffer the full penalty decreed by the written law.

note.seg: Kap. 3ff. wird wiederholt, auszüglich oder wörtlich erstens von Homileten nach Wulfstan 272. 311 bzw. 116. 208 (sie entnehmen Eadgars Namen nicht aus Eg, sondern aus VIII Atr 7), zweitens von V Atr 11. VI 17f. VIII 9ff. I Cn 8ff. Can. Eadg. 54, bei denen jedoch manche Stelle in Kleinigkeiten abweicht und nicht immer nur Eg benutzt

Cap. 3ff. is repeated, in extract or verbatim, firstly by homilists after Wulfstan 272. 311 and 116. 208 respectively (they take Eadgar's name not from Eg but from VIII Atr 7), secondly by V Atr 11. VI 17f. VIII 9ff. I Cn 8ff. Can. Eadg. 54, in which, however, many a passage differs in small details and which do not always use Eg alone
Schon früher scheidet man Vieh und Frucht unter den Erstlingen; s. d. Gl 1
Livestock and crops were distinguished among the first-fruits even earlier; see that word in Gl 1
domboc bedeutet Af-Ine auch sonst; s. Gl Gesetz 4
domboc means Af-Ine elsewhere too; see Gl Gesetz 4
Cf. V Atr. 11, 1; VI, 17 f.; VIII, 9 ff.; I Cn. 8 ff.; Wulfstan’s Homilies, ed. Napier, pp. 116, 208, 272, 310–11.
Cf. I Edw. Pre. and note; II, 5; 5, 2; II As. 5.
